steps.content: (Scene transitions to battlefield, character portraits crack, bleed, then disappear, with sound effects of flesh chunks hitting the ground)

The chaotic hatred does not overcome you. In an instant, the furious mob charging toward you is obliterated—struck mid-stride by artillery shells. Right before your eyes, right above your head, they are shattered, pierced, engulfed in flames, their bodies melted into grotesque pulp and splattered.
You sit on the ground gasping for breath, your body trembling as the world thrums around you. For a moment, you mistake it for the hammering of your own heart.
But no—it's the ground itself trembling beneath you.
[Small CG: Tank]
One after another, the war chariots grind forward like ironclad beasts, crushing bodies and weapons alike into the churned muck.

Inside each chariot, soldiers with indistinct faces clutch bright red arms, their weapons glinting as they rake the earth. They fire without pause, ruthlessly shredding anything that twitches or whimpers in the sludge.
You collapse between the advancing wheels, catching muffled cries from the mud.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: What did we do wrong...? Did we ever harm you?

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: You DisCity people... why are you doing this to us...

The only reply they get is another gunshot. The soldiers kill without hesitation, faces blank as stone, as if they've shed their humanity entirely, becoming little more than the ominous, Mania-emitting weapons they wield.
[Transition] Slow Fade to Black
But the war is far from over.
[Transition, Red In]
Before a roaring bonfire, a soldier drives his bayonet downward, stabbing again and again into a small heap of remains—each thrust mechanical, relentless.
Then, without warning, his blade sinks deep and won't pull free. An instant later, the soldier is yanked forward, swallowed whole by the muck. A stifled gasp, then silence follows.

But then the bayonet resurfaces. It darts across the battlefield now, swift as a viper, piercing soldier after soldier armed with the same deadly steel. Only if you strain your eyes can you glimpse the petite shadow wielding the glowing weapon.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha... Hahahaha!!

Blades, guns, ammunition, and even chariots... One by one, she wrenches the red-glowing weapons from their wielders, cutting down their so-called "masters"—or rather "slaves"—as the armaments coalesce in her grip.
When they finally fuse into those twin blades familiar to you, no one else remains alive on the battlefield.
[Transition] Change the red background to a dark, cold-colored palette
Only a ghost lingers now, her skin a lattice of blood-red scars.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: It's over, right...? It's all over now, right...? I've killed them all... but why...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The fires won't die out, the gunshots keep coming... Why isn't anyone waking up...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Is it still not over? Then... where are the enemies?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The enemies still alive... where are they hiding?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Is it you?!
She finds you in an instant, bursting through the gunsmoke, twin blades a flash of crimson as they carve toward your face.
[Release the shackles]

Your shackles barely block her strike, several thorns piercing through her body only to be instantly dissolved and absorbed. No advantage is gained; instead, the Sinner's madness penetrates your mind, carried on the razor's edge of her scream.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Stop? Why?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: If not killing means being killed, then why should I stop?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: If not killing means losing people I care about, then why should I stop?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: None of you ever stopped! You were the ones who started it!
Her furious roar splits your skull. Your consciousness shudders, disrupted by her rage, but a voice deep within urges you to reject her words—
You open your mouth to speak, but the words that spill forth are no longer yours.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were the ones who started it. You choked us, left us no way out...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop acting innocent! The soldiers you trained have my people's blood on their hands! And you did nothing to stop them!

steps.speaker: Delirious Voice Within
steps.content: When they dropped ████, you supported them. You let it happen. You are guilty—ALL of you!
[Shackles Effect, No Interaction Required]

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Not true...? What is not true...? You are not our enemy?

Your words are cut short as something coils around your ankles. Your gaze snaps downward, and there, you find eyes adrift in a sea of blood—eyes that refuse to close even in death—staring directly at you.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Die with us... then you won't be an enemy... As long as you live, you are our enemy!

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: This is what war is like! This is the war you taught me!!

steps.speaker: Vague Voice & Jasmine
steps.content: You started this war, and you think it can just end that easily?
You turn around to see a sight that fills you with warmth, comfort, and familiarity. They appear to be your companions.
[Small CG: Army]
It's a real army. And every single one of them...
...holds the same deadly blade, each radiating palpable bloodlust.
In the laboratory, alarms blare as everyone scrambles into action, holding their breath with cold sweat streaming down their faces.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Resonance levels have exceeded the danger threshold. Increase the inhibitor dosage, weaken the shackles, and if possible, sever the connection again. ${PlayerName}'s condition is on the verge of losing control. Hold him back.
steps.female_content: Resonance levels have exceeded the danger threshold. Increase the inhibitor dosage, weaken the shackles, and if possible, sever the connection again. ${PlayerName}'s condition is on the verge of losing control. Hold her back.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If SHP-13 still can't wake up in 15 minutes, proceed with final measures: activate containment protocols to protect ${PlayerName} and execute Jasmine simultaneously to prevent contamination residue.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This contamination is beyond anything an S-Class Sinner could wield. What's truly tearing through her mind is...
The cold, rational triangle commands the scene, but beyond its mechanical gaze, more eyes are watching as everything unfolds.

steps.speaker: Schorl?
steps.content: Heh... It's certainly not those petty nobles from Fraser. What will ultimately break this Sinner? I'm afraid they're just as curious about the experiment results as we are...

steps.speaker: Schorl?
steps.content: Stay calm, Chief. I know you can do this. Try to keep a clear head and find the voice you truly believe in... The answer is there.
